title: test(react): carry the retired `view` member as a STORED body, not as authored metadata (objectui#10080)
body:
Fixes #10080

Clause-②: no — this is a test fixture's own type annotation. It moves no exported symbol, no key on a published payload, and relaxes no accept set.

⚠️ Generic parameters are written as UPPERCASE WORDS in this body, never literally in angle brackets: GitHub's body sanitizer deletes tag-shaped fragments on save, and neither backticks nor fenced code blocks protect them (AGENTS.md, "GitHub mutates body BYTES"). A before/after table whose two columns collapse into the same string is exactly the failure this spelling avoids.

## What changed, and why it is a split rather than a deletion

`packages/react/src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` had ONE declaration doing TWO jobs, and `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's retirement of `navigation.view` (ADR-0049) pulled them apart:

- the **objectui#4550 TYPE pin** is the ANNOTATION — a spec-authored config that omits `mode` is accepted by the alias;
- the **objectui#9874 BEHAVIOUR pin** is the VALUE — a stored body carrying the retired key must not let that name reach `onNavigate`'s navigation-MODE slot.

The spec types the retired key as NEVER on the authoring side, so the value can no longer be spelled where the annotation is. One fixture per job now:

- `AUTHORED_WITHOUT_MODE` keeps `SpecAuthoredInput` OF `NavigationConfigSchema` and authors `size: 'lg'` — a key the spec still declares, and the very example `useNavigationOverlay`'s own header gives for authored metadata that lets `mode` default.
- `STORED_WITH_RETIRED_VIEW` is a RECORD of STRING to UNKNOWN, asserted once to `NavigationConfig` at the boundary, and carries `view: 'summary_view'` into the two rows that measure its inertness. The shape is copied from `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNavigationMembers-8071.test.tsx`, which fed the same legacy body through a record parameter and kept both of its rows through the retirement.

⛔ Nothing was deleted and no assertion was weakened. The disagreement row still reads `expect(onNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r1', 'view')` beside `expect(onNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('r1', 'summary_view')`, and both it and the state-shape row still receive `{ view: 'summary_view' }` — byte for byte the value they received before. Both file headers were updated to say which fixture carries which job and why the stored body is not typed through the authoring schema; the parts that were still accurate were left alone.

## The gate leg: 1 diagnostic to 0, with the control lit in the same command

**Was the injection reproducible? YES.** `scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs` lives on PR #9877's branch (`origin/claude/issue-9860-spec-main-shape-gate`, `fdb1b33f`), not on `main`. Its `inject()` was imported unmodified and called with `repoRoot`, which is a parameter of that function — the CLI omits it only because on a runner the script sits inside the repo it injects into. Everything else followed the workflow: `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main` at `cdedfb348dd71738a7772a8e0d6d13f12ba06d14`, `npm pack --ignore-scripts`, remove-then-copy into the worktree's pnpm virtual store. The script's own verification passed: **29 workspace consumers** confirmed resolving the injected copy.

Every leg printed the switch state — which spec the compiler resolves, and what it declares for the `view` member — in the SAME command as the reading, so no number can be attributed to the wrong corpus.

| leg | spec under the compiler | tree | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CONTROL, before | published pin 17.4.0, `view` is OPT of `z.ZodString` | `0c2eb5eee` (origin/main) | **0 diagnostics**, exit 0 |
| SUBJECT, before | injected main build, `view` is OPT of `z.ZodNever` | `0c2eb5eee` | **1 diagnostic**, exit 2 |
| SUBJECT, after | injected main build, same declaration | `e46593079` | **0 diagnostics**, exit 0 |
| CONTROL, after | published pin restored | `424a89353` | **0 diagnostics**, exit 0 |

The one diagnostic, verbatim, and the only one the package reported:

```
src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx(76,3): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'.
```

⭐ The control is not decoration. A zero from the published pin says the change did not buy its green by breaking compilation against everything, and the same published pin is what declares `view` as OPT of `z.ZodString` — which is why the file compiled there all along.

## Ablations — both proved on disk, never by an exit code

Run through `ablation-replace`, which refuses an anchor that does not hit, verifies the write against the disk, and proves the restore against the HEAD blob.

**A. The green is not a vacuous green.** Re-spelling `view: 'summary_view'` inside the `SpecAuthoredInput` literal, under the SAME injected spec, brings the diagnostic straight back at the member's new line:

```
src/hooks/__tests__/useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx(94,3): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'undefined'.
```

Mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob `30f311446b83` to `5f0c51587a5d`. Restored: blob back to `30f311446b83`, equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. This is the file still being in tsc's corpus AND the diagnostic being caused by exactly that member in exactly that annotation.

**B. The disagreement row can still fail.** Moving the stored name into the MODE slot — the position the retired read used to put it — turns that row and only that row red:

```
FAIL … routes a click through the `page` branch WITHOUT a stored `view` reaching the mode slot (objectui#9874)
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 'r1', 'view' ]
Number of calls: 0
Tests  1 failed | 16 passed (17)
```

Mutation landed: blob `30f311446b83` to `5f55a9323412`. Restored: blob back to `30f311446b83`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

⚠️ **NOT MEASURED, declared:** a firing control for the second assertion (`.not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('r1', 'summary_view')`) requires the hook to reintroduce the substitution, and the hook is outside this PR's one-file surface. No path in the current implementation dispatches an arbitrary string into that slot, so that half cannot be fired from the fixture side. It is stated rather than quietly skipped.

## Tests and gates

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react exec vitest run … useNavigationOverlay.modeDefault.test.tsx` — **17 passed (17)**.
- the whole package: **89 test files, 1127 tests, all passed**.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` — exit 0 (see the table).
- `check-changeset-presence` — RED first ("1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset"), which is why this PR carries `.changeset/10080-modedefault-fixture-stored-body.md` with an EMPTY frontmatter. That is the gate's own sanctioned answer for a change that releases nothing ("the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate"), not a workaround, and it is the only file in this PR besides the fixture. Nothing in `@object-ui/react`'s published `files` (`dist`, README, CHANGELOG, LICENSE) moves.
- also green on the exact pushed tree: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-control-bytes` (8117 files scanned), `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new citations — the precedent file is cited by path, deliberately without a line number), `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`.
- `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on both paths: NOT GOVERNED, 2 paths checked against 5 governed surfaces.
- eslint on the changed file: 1 file linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings. ⚠️ Narrowed on purpose: the repo-wide lint farm is CI's run, not this one's.

## What this PR does not do

⛔ It does not re-declare `view`, does not add a deprecated alias, and does not work around the tombstone at the spec level — objectui#9874 was ruled **A** and objectui is a consumer here. It stays DRAFT; no label was applied, ready was not flipped, and auto-merge was not armed.
